caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a female figure standing upright on a green rectangular pedestal. The figure has brown skin and is dressed in an ancient-style light blue tunic, gathered at the waist with a red sash. She wears a golden helmet with a red plume, a wide gold necklace decorated with red elements, and gold armbands on both arms. The right arm is bent at the elbow and raised, holding up a severed head with green hair. The left arm extends downward at her side, with the hand relaxed. The figure wears green knee guards with yellow accents and dark brown shoes. The statue and pedestal are centered on a plain beige background. The artist's signature, "EMILE CIRIO," appears in small letters near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
